parts.name: Cap
parts.Basic_description: This is the cap of a pen, made of plastic, cylindrical in shape, and designed to cover the pen tip.
parts.Functional_description: The cap protects the pen tip from drying out and prevents ink leakage when not in use.
parts.Movement_description: It can be removed or attached to the pen body by pulling or snapping it into place.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the pen, made of plastic, elongated and tapered for comfortable grip.
parts.Functional_description: It houses the ink reservoir and writing tip, serving as the main structure for writing.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use, except for the writing motion controlled by the user’s hand.
